name: mdx-pages-world-model-projection
human_line: What a page rests on, what rests on it, and where the company is talking about it - every relationship derived from recorded bodies and receipts, never asserted.

relationships.cites_receipts: receipt-id shaped tokens found in the page's recorded body
relationships.cites_pages: another page's title or id named in the body
relationships.cited_by_pages: the reverse of cites_pages, computed over the whole corpus
relationships.decision_mentions: recorded Decision: messages naming the page's title, with channel and receipt
relationships.thread_mentions: recorded conversation messages naming the page's title

declared_not_built.forge_run_links: lands when Forge runs carry page references in their contracts

surface: the reader's How-this-page-connects panel, with cited pages one click away and an honest empty state
